newsitem.title: CHINA: OLYMPICS-CHINA TABLE TENNIS CHAMP JOINS IOC PANEL.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-CHINA TABLE TENNIS CHAMP JOINS IOC PANEL.

text.p: China's world and Olympic women's table tennis champion Deng Yaping has been selected as a member of the Athlete Commission of the International Olympic Committee (IOC), the Chinese Olympic Committee announced on Wednesday.

The 24-year-old Deng has won four Olympic gold medals and 15 world titles. She won the table tennis singles gold medal after the doubles victory with teammate Qiao Hong at the Atlanta Olympics last year.

The Athlete Commission, responsible for protecting athletes' interests worldwide, has 19 members. The previous China representative was gymnast Li Ning, who won 15 world men's gymnastic titles before he retired in 1988.

IOC president Antonio Samaranch had notified China of the decision to appoint Deng to the commission, the Xinhua news agency quoted Wei Jizhong, secretary-general of China's Olympic Committee, as saying.
